reported_success.quote: This study demonstrated no overall relationship between priming condition and ratings of cleansing products

notes:
Requested test statistic extracted for overall cleansing desirability. Authors report an isolated toothpaste willingness-to-pay result but describe the replication overall as unsuccessful; that different test was not substituted. Analytic n left null because only recruitment count and exclusions are printed. Original acquisition was not retried because texts/683877f6912e782beacf0340.miss records failed author-hosted copies and no OpenAlex OA location. No original statistics were extracted from secondary descriptions in the replication paper. Supplied replication page locator appears to use a different pagination; study identifier and cleansing-desirability test matched independently in the published article.
Source follow-up: Primary source title and authors verified: Zhong and Liljenquist, Science 313 (2006), pp. 1451–1452; supplied JSTOR published-article OCR. Only the assigned original side was examined.
